d:
Pakistan ke lahaur men chal rahi surtal ekedmi ke ye bachche soshal midiya par apni anokhi dhunon aur sangit ke zarie khas pahchan bana rahe hain. sangit ke prati prem, tailent aur kuchh anokha rachne ka junun in yuva aartist ko sabse alag banata hai. bibisi ki is riport men surtal ekedmi ke in tailented bachchon se milie.
Vidiyoh furqan ilahi
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
